title: Bongo All Gamemodes
description: For those who want to enjoy more game modes in the Bongo mod and save themselves the time of creating a datapack.
body:
For those who want to enjoy more game modes in the Bongo mod and save themselves the time of creating a datapack.

The available game modes include:
- ALL 25: Complete all 25 tasks to win.
- One Task: Complete only one task to win.
- Rows: You can only complete rows to win.
- Columns: You can only complete columns to win.
- Diagonals: You can only complete diagonals to win.
- Rows & Columns: Complete a row or column to win.
- One Row & One Column: Complete one row and one column to win.

Use the same command you would use to start a game:

```
/bingo create tasks_id settings_id
```
Where "Settings_id" is the game mode to choose.
